title: GENERAL MICROBIOLOGY LABORATORY
description: Development of laboratory techniques; exercises designed to reinforce concepts covered in MB 302.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: MB 302* or 302H*.
* May be taken concurrently.
A minimum grade of D- is required in MB 302 and MB 302H.
books_html: Low-cost:  Course material total cost is $40 or less.
meeting_html: R 1pm-4:50pm in NASH 304 - Nash Hall 304 (9/23 to 12/4)
